runs.text: Which dog is Israel? Six clues. Clue one: small. About twenty two thousand square kilometres. Roughly New Jersey. Clue two: smart. six point three percent of its economy goes into research. Number one among rich countries. Clue three: loyal. Since nineteen forty eight, about three point four million immigrants came home. Clue four: guards the house. Iron Dome stops over ninety percent of the rockets aimed at its cities. Clue five: blamed for every bark. From twenty fifteen to twenty twenty three, the United Nations General Assembly passed one hundred and fifty four resolutions against Israel. The rest of the world combined? seventy one. Clue six: a <<ˈ|d|ɛ|z|ɚ|t>> dog that found water. Drip irrigation was born here, in nineteen sixty five. And it shares the bowl: in twenty twenty one, it doubled the water it sends Jordan. So which breed? A Belgian Malinois. Small, tireless, smart, protective. It's the main breed in the Israeli army's dog unit, Oketz. No dog is perfect. Judge it like every other dog on the street. What dog would your country be? Now you know the answer to:
